retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic composition featuring a long-exposure photographic subject with horizontal motion trails and tightly stacked, multi-weight sans-serif typography in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, high-contrast image where a central figure is rendered as a series of overlapping, blurred frames suggesting rapid horizontal movement. The figure wears colorful, patterned clothing that creates painterly streaks of red, blue, and purple against a solid black background. The top right quadrant contains a dense block of text with varying weights and colors.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal motion trails vs. static black background
Vibrant primary-colored figure vs. yellow and white typography
Dense typographic block anchored to the top right corner
Repetitive rhythmic patterns in the blurred subject
coreInvariants: Horizontal motion blur effect on the subject
Solid black background for high contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The blurred figure occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, stretching horizontally across the entire width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The sharp, bright yellow text block in the upper right corner acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the horizontal motion of the figure from left to right, then moves upward to the dense text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The top left quadrant is dominated by solid black negative space, balancing the heavy text on the right.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red, Blue, and Purple (Subject Motion Trails)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject and text against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical stacking with minimal leading
Mixing of bold and light weights within the same block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans-serif paired with a delicate, slanted script for contrast.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule (underline) beneath the script text
Tight vertical stacking of text lines

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric sans-serif structure of the primary text.
Provides a similar informal, slanted script feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a long-exposure photograph of a person in colorful patterned clothing moving horizontally across a black background, creating vibrant motion trails.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a block of right-aligned text in the top right corner. Use a bold yellow sans-serif for the main title and a white script font for the subtitle, separated by a thin white horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the motion blur horizontal and rhythmic?
Is the text block tightly stacked in the upper right?
Is there a clear contrast between the yellow and white text?

adjustableVariables: Color palette of the subject's clothing
Specific font weights in the typographic stack
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific brand logos in the corners
Ensure the motion blur does not obscure the face entirely
postGenerationChecks: Check for horizontal alignment of motion trails
Verify the yellow color is vibrant and saturated
Ensure the script text is legible against the black
Confirm the typographic hierarchy is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Kinetic Motion Blur + Stacked Geometric Sans + High Contrast Black
